subject: how to add text to a stat=qq plot?

messages.author: 4e69b94a09c8cf3b
messages.subject: how to add text to a stat=qq plot?
parts:
Maybe someone can point me in a sane direction.

I have a long data frame (sample below as soilms).  I want to plot qq plots for each of a set of variables.  I would like to add the results of a shapiro.text (p-value) as text on each of the plots.  Before trying such a thing I figured I would just try to put text on the plots. 

No dice on adding the geom_text below.  This has worked with other faceted plots (geom_density, for example). 

Assuming this can be made to work, should I be able to use aes_string to set the label along the lines of label="shapiro.test(value)$p.value"?  In the same vein, can I expect to reference x and y using ..theoretical.. and ..sample.. (inside strings)?  Different approach all together?

vars<- c("clay_pc","sand_pc","silt_pc","porosity","theta_fc","theta_pwp","theta_a")
p <- ggplot(subset(soilms,variable %in% vars)) + 
aes(sample=value,color=variable) + 
geom_point(stat="qq") + facet_wrap(~ variable) + 
opts(legend.position="none")


p # plots nicely


p + geom_text(aes(x,y), data=data.frame(x=65,y=-1.75),label="aLabel")

messages.subject: Re: how to add text to a stat=qq plot?
parts: You should combine the two lines:

to

geom_point(aes(.....), stat='qq')

Then the geom_text will work.

Xie Chao
